headline_findings: Domestic manufacturing share of India smartwatch shipments jumped to 82% in Q3 2023 from 4% a year earlier (Counterpoint report title; details paywalled). [secondary]

IDC: India wearables shipped 114.2M units in 2025 (-4.0% YoY, second annual decline); smartwatches 28.9M (-17.6%); smartwatch ASP rose 11.7% to USD 26.5 (from USD 23.8 in 2024); overall wearables ASP USD 20.3 (+1.8%). [secondary, quoting IDC April 2026 release]
Counterpoint: India smartwatch shipments fell 27% YoY in Q2 2025 (fifth straight quarterly decline; Q1 2025 was -33%); Noise, boAt and Titan/Fastrack held 62% combined share. [secondary]

boAt's updated DRHP (Oct 2025): 75.83% of units made in India in Q1 FY2026 vs 39.65% in FY2023; >75M units produced domestically to date; wearables were Rs 330.41 crore = 10.76% of FY2025 revenue; the 50:50 Dixon JV Califonix made 13.44M units in FY25 at 44.80% utilisation of a 30M-unit installed capacity. [secondary, quoting the SEBI filing]

Dixon Q1 FY26 earnings call: wearables & hearables segment revenue INR 175 crore for the quarter with "healthy operating margin"; smartwatches added to the portfolio with the existing customer. Per-unit conversion charges were not disclosed. [secondary, transcript]
Optiemus Electronics runs two Noida plants, designs and manufactures hearables for Noise, planned a new Noida wearables factory (Dec 2024) and targets >10M units/yr by end-2025. [secondary]

Ultrahuman's US UltraFactory (Plano, TX) opened at 200,000 rings/yr and is ramping to >500,000/yr (~400/day now, 1,350/day planned by end-2025); the company says it is modelled on its first India facility, but Indore capacity/output figures were not found. [verified for US numbers via Ultrahuman press releases; Indore: not found]
India tooling NRE indications: injection-mold tooling Rs 2 lakh to Rs 30 lakh+ per tool (Moldrite 2026); jigs/fixtures Rs 60,000 to Rs 6 lakh (IndiaMART). [blog-grade]

FCC cost ladder (MarkReady 2026): SDoC USD 1,500-5,000; device using a pre-certified Wi-Fi/BLE module USD 3,000-10,000; full custom RF testing USD 8,000-200,000+. Indian labs with FCC/CE wireless capability: TUV SUD Bengaluru (10 m semi-anechoic chamber), UL Solutions India Bengaluru, STQC (Bangalore, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune and others). Indian lab price lists were not found. [secondary]

PMP for wearables (Union Budget 2022-23): 20% basic customs duty on finished smartwatches/hearables; component duty ladder 0-15% across FY23-FY26 with most component duties nil from 1 Apr 2022. What applies from FY27 (i.e. now) was not found. [secondary; Global Trade Alert / Business Standard / KNN]

Per-unit India EMS conversion/box-build charges for a wearable were NOT found in any public source after 14 targeted searches; this number must come from RFQs. The only listed figure (Tri-Sol Technology, Pune, "Rs 0.25 per piece" on IndiaMART) has no stated basis and cannot be used. [not found]

FX for synthesis: USD/INR spot on 14 Sep 2026 is about Rs 95.7 per USD (BookMyForex daily rate page; Federal Reserve H.10 lists the official series). Use Rs 95.7/USD for every INR↔USD conversion in the brief; the Rs 85/USD rate used inside india-manufacturing.json is stale and must be re-based. [secondary]

detailed_notes:
# India supplement (main-session searches, 2026-09-14)

## Market (IDC / Counterpoint)
- 2025 full year (IDC, Apr 2026 release, via FoneArena/BizTechReports): wearables 114.2M units (-4.0%), smartwatches 28.9M (-17.6%), smartwatch ASP USD 26.5 (+11.7% from 23.8), overall wearables ASP USD 20.3 (+1.8%). Volumes fell for the second year while ASPs rose: the market is premiumising slightly, not collapsing further in price.
- IDC 2Q25: 27M units, -9% YoY (IDC's own release). IDC 2024: -11.3% (first ever annual decline).
- Counterpoint Q2 2025: smartwatch shipments -27% YoY (fifth straight decline); Noise + boAt + Titan/Fastrack = 62%.
- Counterpoint Q3 2023: domestic manufacturing share of smartwatch shipments 82% (from 4%). This is the headline proof that India can assemble wearables at scale; it was driven by the 20% finished-goods duty + nil component duty ladder (PMP).

## Who builds (from filings and calls)
- boAt UDRHP (Oct 2025): 75.83% of units made in India in Q1 FY26 (39.65% in FY23); Califonix (50:50 Dixon JV) 30M units/yr installed capacity, 13.44M units in FY25 (44.8% utilisation), 3.19M in Q1 FY26 (37.46% of boAt units). Wearables = Rs 330.41 crore = 10.76% of FY25 revenue. Note: Califonix is described as an audio JV; smartwatch assembly for boAt is at Dixon per the Dixon Q1 FY26 call ("added smart watches with the existing customer").
- Dixon Q1 FY26 call: wearables & hearables revenue INR 175 crore/quarter, "healthy operating margin and very good ROCE". No per-unit numbers.
- Optiemus Electronics: two Noida plants; designs and makes hearables for Noise; planned a dedicated Noida wearables factory (Dec 2024); target >10M units/yr by end-2025 across categories.
- East India Technologies (Greater Noida) advertises OEM/ODM smartwatch manufacturing (vendor page, eitplems.com). Syrma SGS, Avalon, Kaynes provide PCBA + box build (vendor/industry pages).
- Ultrahuman: US UltraFactory (Plano, TX) 200k → >500k rings/yr, ~400/day now; "based on the company's first operational model of such a facility in India". Indore capacity, output and cost: not found.

## NRE indications (India)
- Injection-mold tooling Rs 2-30+ lakh per tool (Moldrite 2026 vendor blog). A screenless band needs roughly 3-5 tools (housing, back/optical window, strap/buckle, charger) — that count is an estimate, not sourced.
- Jigs/fixtures Rs 60k-6 lakh each (IndiaMART).

## Certification
- FCC (MarkReady 2026): SDoC USD 1.5-5k; pre-certified BLE module route USD 3-10k; custom RF USD 8k-200k+. Using a pre-certified nRF52 module is the cheapest path.
- Indian labs: TUV SUD Bengaluru (10 m SAC, Bluetooth/Wi-Fi/SRD, FCC-capable), UL Solutions India Bengaluru, STQC labs. Prices not published.

## Policy
- PMP for wearables (Budget 2022-23): 20% BCD on finished smartwatches/hearables; component duties 0-15% FY23-FY26, most nil from 1 Apr 2022. FY27 status: not found.

## Not found (must come from RFQ)
- Per-unit India EMS SMT + box-build charge for a wearable at 5k/25k/100k.
- India per-unit conversion cost vs China/Vietnam (ELCINA benchmark).
- Ultrahuman Indore numbers.
- Indian lab price lists for FCC/CE.
